findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of products covered under the agreement, detailing the categories of products and services to be supplied by the Vendor to the Client.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement covers the following categories of products supplied by Vendor to Client: Servers (Rack-mounted, Blade, and Tower), Networking Equipment (Switches, Routers, Firewalls), Storage Solutions (NAS, SAN, Cloud-enabled Storage), Peripheral Devices (UPS, Printers, Scanners), Consumables (Cables, Connectors, Batteries).
